manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up two the shoe with padded collar and tongue, tips left, into the medium cardboard shoe-box.

Task description: Place the two black-and-white athletic shoes with padded collars and tongues into the open medium orange paper shoebox in the center, with both toes pointing left.

Success criteria: In the current overhead image, place the shoe left of the box in its lower-central region and the right shoe in its upper-central region. Both must lie flat at the box bottom, soles down and toes left in the image, with both grippers open and releasing them.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the thicker sides of the rear half of the shoe below the collar, spanning its width and avoiding the protruding tongue and laces. Open slightly wider than that section to reduce contact with the box rim during approach.
- Before closing, confirm fingers on opposite upper sides of the shoe with pads covering relatively flat areas, avoiding mere image overlap or sole-edge-only contact. Check for sliding during a small lift.
- When turning the shoe toe, keep the whole shoe above the box rim and leave room for both toe and heel to rotate, avoiding the box wall, other shoe, or drink cup behind it.
- Lower shoes with soles approximately parallel to the box bottom, leaving finger withdrawal clearance from walls and the other shoe. Release once the box bottom supports them and watch for fingertips catching the shoe collar during withdrawal.
